before.title: High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) for canine urothelial carcinoma
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by ESVONC/Oncowaf
before.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the trial team.
before.notes: HIFU anticancer treatment study for canine urothelial carcinoma when conventional treatment has been refused, is not applicable, or has failed. Oncowaf lists cytologic/histologic confirmation and ability to undergo general anesthesia among criteria.

before.title: Intratumoral immunotherapy for canine oral malignant tumors
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by ESVONC/Oncowaf
before.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with VetAgro Sup.
before.notes: Intratumoral immunotherapy for stage I–III oral melanoma or oral SCC with measurable disease at least 1 cm. Oncowaf lists no distant metastases and no prior treatment beyond surgical resection among key criteria.

before.title: Microwave or radiofrequency thermoablation for canine hepatocellular carcinoma
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
before.notes: Microwave or radiofrequency thermoablation for primary hepatocellular carcinoma or limited hepatic metastases; public criteria specify 1–6 cm lesions, normal hepatic function, no coagulopathy and ability to undergo anesthesia.

before.title: Local microwave treatment for canine chemodectoma
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
before.notes: Local microwave treatment for non-metastatic chemodectoma, including tumors increasing in size under other treatments.

before.title: Photodynamic therapy for canine mammary tumors
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
before.funding: Confirm costs with University of Évora.
before.notes: Photodynamic anticancer treatment study for female dogs with mammary tumors; Oncowaf lists age up to 12 years and excludes metastatic disease and serious comorbidity.

before.title: Autologous hydroxyapatite-based cancer vaccine for canine mucosal melanoma
before.center: AniCura I Portoni Rossi / University of Teramo
before.status: Ongoing European oncology clinical trial — listed by Oncowaf
before.contacts: Riccardo Finotello — riccardo.finotello@anicura.it; Valentina Rinaldi — vrinaldi@unite.it
before.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the investigators.
before.notes: Autologous hydroxyapatite-based cancer vaccine study for mucosal melanoma. The primary tumor must still be available for vaccine preparation; previously excised/formalin-fixed-only tumors are not eligible.
